properties.description:
Detects network share discovery in two ways.
1) Share-listing commands (net view, net share, Get-SmbShare, PowerView and similar) run with a risk
indicator: non-admin account, unusual parent process, admin or hidden shares, several targets, or
attack-tool strings.
2) A process with no legitimate need for SMB (e.g. dllhost.exe not started by svchost, rundll32)
connecting to internal hosts over SMB; High if it also queried AD over LDAP.
Built from purple team findings. Exclusions for sanctioned remoting accounts are read from the
DetectionExclusions watchlist.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{ReasonsText}}. Account: {{AccountName}}. Check the parent process and what ran before it, then whether any listed shares were accessed.
